description.value: A large mid-elevation grassland park southwest of Kamloops anchored by two stocked rainbow trout lakes, with 275 campsites across three campgrounds and paved access; curious marmots are abundant and known to chew gear and damage vehicles.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Tunkwa Park is an active provincial campground on the southern Thompson Plateau, accessible via 24 km of paved road from Savona or 16 km from Logan Lake. The park page links to 'Reservation policies' under 'Know before you go' and the frontcountry camping subpage confirms reservations are available at over 110 provincial park campgrounds, supporting reservations=true. No cycling-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, showers, device charging, etc.) appear anywhere in the website content; OSM tag internet_access=no is consistent with the remote setting but does not address device charging directly.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-320-9305) is attributed to operator Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd. and is not explicitly listed or corroborated on the BC Parks website, which shows only general BC Parks contact numbers.
No civic address in OSM record; location described in website text only (southern Thompson Plateau, ~40 km SW of Kamloops via Tunkwa Lake Road).
Website content is sparse on specific campground amenities (water, showers, bear lockers, etc.) so many optional amenities could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks provincial campground fully accessible via paved road with a confirmed online reservation system; a legitimate overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Kamloops–Logan Lake corridor.

wow_evidence: 275 campsites across three campgrounds and paved access
